title: Add a CLI subcommand
summary: Adds one subcommand to the existing command line, with --json output and a test.
goal: Add a CLI subcommand `{name}` to the existing command line in {cli_module}. It should {behaviour}. Existing subcommands must behave exactly as before. Add a test in {test_dir}/ that runs it and checks the exit code.

params.name: behaviour
params.label: What it does
params.default: print a summary of the stored data
